correctness.rationale: Full proof expands B;order steps to Hasse arcs and vice versa, then applies unique paths to simple and rooted criteria. Necessity of a minimal root follows from an unrestricted upward path. Weighted inclusion-exclusion gives coefficients exactly for all finite loop sets. The unrestricted theorem depends on the proof, not the finite checks.

value.rationale: Provides a complete natural-family classification and exact loop-count polynomials for every finite poset with tree cover graph, a large structurally defined set of temporal modal test frames. The root obstruction sets interact and can yield more SI than simple decorations already on a four-point oriented tree, unlike a mere renamed Z-test. The exact enumerator is motivated by the paper’s dual SI/simple characterization; it is not a free numerical table or isolated tiny improvement.
